key_points: Institutional net ETF buying of $79.2 million on Nov 11 signals strong demand.
Insider purchases, including $9.7 million by CEO Lip‑Bu Tan and a $79.2 million ETF inflow, indicate confidence.
Analyst upgrade to 'Strong Buy' after a 38% sell‑off suggests optimism on turnaround.
Valuation narrative claims up to 88% undervaluation, implying significant upside potential.
Macro headwinds from Nvidia CEO resignation and AI sector volatility may cause short‑term volatility but not fundamental change.
